description_en: Retrieves multimedia file information, such as encoding, bitrate, resolution, and stream details
description_zh: 获取多媒体文件信息，如编码、码率、分辨率、流信息等
kebab_example: aliyun imm get-media-meta --project immvideotest --media-uri oss://imm-test/testcases/video.mp4 --api-version 2017-09-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetMediaMeta

parameters.help_en:
The OSS URI of the video.

The OSS URI follows the format `oss://bucket/object`, where bucket is the name of the OSS bucket in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path
parameters.help_zh:
视频的OSS URI。

OSS地址规则为`oss://bucket/object`，其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的OSS Bucket名称，object为文件路径
parameters.name: media_uri
